lines.trans: Where did this girl run so quickly?
She just ran straight to the restroom.
Did she suddenly feel ill in the dining room?
Yes, she was just feeling very nauseous.
Could she really have gotten poisoned by our food?
We do not know the exact reason yet.
In the kitchen all products are always fresh.
But the guest felt ill after lunch.
What if this is a secret restaurant critic?
Then our restaurant has big problems.
We must urgently check everything in the kitchen.
I will go and find out her condition.
I hope everything ends well for us.

meanings.note: the comparative 'быстрее', often as an order

examples.trans: I grew up in a communal flat.
Why did it suddenly draw level?

meanings.note: at the start of a sentence

examples.text: Девушки, как я, у тебя не будет!
examples.trans: You'll never have a girl like me!
We could open a salon for you.

examples.text: В этом ресторане всегда свежая еда.
examples.trans: There is always fresh food in this restaurant.

meanings.note: the thing that ends is the subject
деньги закончились = the money ran out

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.
A strict critic is sitting in the hall.

meanings.note: for movement; где is for location

examples.trans: Three rooms and a big kitchen.

meanings.en: other forms: нас (gen/acc), нам (dat), нами (instr), нас (prep)

examples.trans: The programme is on the website.
He is running for a second term.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates

examples.text: Мы сделали много, но надо ещё.
examples.trans: We've done a lot, but we need more.
I want to, but I can't.

meanings.en: it is necessary, one needs to
meanings.note: + dative of the person + infinitive: мне нужно позвонить

examples.trans: I need to make a call.

побежать.gloss: to start running, to run off

meanings.en: to break into a run, to run off

examples.text: Схватил собачку в парке и побежал.
examples.trans: Grab the little dog in the park and run.
The boy quickly ran off home.

meanings.note: as a conjunction: пока я сплю

examples.text: Нет причин держать вас под арестом.
examples.trans: There is no reason to keep you under arrest.

meanings.en: to check, to test, to verify

examples.text: Слушай, Нина, это же тот самый ресторан!
examples.trans: Listen, Nina, this is that very restaurant!

examples.text: Мы рады видеть вас в нашем ресторане.
examples.trans: We are glad to see you in our restaurant.
The wind is blowing hard outside.
Checking the condition of the wall.

meanings.en: urgently, right away; predicative: it is urgent

examples.trans: I need to make a phone call urgently.

meanings.note: at the start of a question

examples.trans: So I shouldn't wait for you?

meanings.note: impersonal: меня тошнит = I feel sick
меня тошнит от... = I'm sick of...

examples.trans: The toilet is in the corridor.

meanings.note: irregular mixed conjugation: убегу, убежишь, ..., убегут

examples.trans: The dog ran away into the courtyard.
I'll find out where he is.

meanings.note: points at something: это моё = that's mine

meanings.en: other forms: этого, этому, это, этим, этом

examples.trans: I'm sick of this communal flat.

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
